listed_sector_signals.signal: Reference-list citation to a study of the Swedish pulp and paper industry (a listed continuous-flow sector), cited only as prior barriers/drivers literature, not applied in this paper
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Thollander P, Ottosson M. An energy efﬁcient Swedish pulp and paper in-
dustry e exploring barriers to and driving forces for cost-effective energy
efﬁciency investments. Energy Efﬁc Feb. 2008;1(1):21e34.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Combined heat and power (CHP) plant proposed as a candidate energy-efficiency capital project at a medical-device manufacturing site (cogeneration technology), evaluated but in a discrete-manufacturing context
Tri-generation / combined-heat-and-power described as low-carbon on-site generation technology deployed at sites
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
Low carbon technology is referred mainly to the use of combined-heat and
power and tri-generation units that help reduce CO2 emissions given its higher
efﬁciencies when compared with traditional thermal generation plants.

one_line: The paper develops and pilots a Global Energy Management System methodology at Boston Scientific, a non-energy-intensive multi-site medical-device (life sciences) manufacturer — discrete manufacturing with clean-room space conditioning, not continuous-flow production; Corpus-B sectors appear only via a pulp-and-paper reference citation and proposed CHP/tri-generation energy projects.
